text:
irene: Heads up — Product wants a 'Key discovery' surface in the Console: per-route list of active API keys + effective project/org. Need platform/security thoughts.

sam: Quick take: we can derive the effective project from token claims (iss, proj). The problem is tokens minted by proxies or cross-org impersonation may lose origin info.

luke: Also, we should avoid showing full KIDs in the UI. Show truncated KID (last 6) + link to audit view. :lock:

maya: What does 'active' mean here? Last seen? Active session? Product asked for "last 7 days" and top 5 routes.

irene: Correct. They also want a one-click 'Revoke' for tokens from the UI.

sam: Revoke needs to be authoritative — API should hit /internal/sa/revoke and purge prefix caches at the edge. Expect a ~30s invalidation window for KV caches.

natalie: From telemetry/billing POV we need to emit both effective_project and origin_project where possible. Also capture service_account if present, so quotas and billing attribution are accurate.

luke: Proposed internal resolution endpoint (sketch):

```
GET /internal/keys/{kid}/resolve
Response:
{
  "kid": "k_abc123...xyz",
  "effective_project": "proj-123",
  "origin_project": "proj-456",
  "service_account": "svc-ingest",
  "last_seen": "2026-03-10T12:34:56Z"
}
```

maya: Security note: showing origin_project might leak cross-org relationships. We should gate that field by viewer perms (org-admin) or redact for lower perms.

sam: Agreed. Gate by permission check server-side. For non-authorized users show hashed KID + "redacted" origin.

irene: Rollout suggestion: behind feature-flag `console.key_discovery_v1`, start internal + enterprise accounts only.

luke: Add an audit event on revoke: `audit-bot: key_revoked user=<who> kid=<kid> reason=<opt>`.

deploy-bot: deploy/console-key-discovery v1 scheduled to canary Monday 09:00 UTC (CI job: deploy/console-key-discovery).

natalie: Billing rule: use effective_project for billing and quota enforcement. UI should show an explainer: "billing may apply to a different project than the token's origin".

sam: UX detail — revoke must warn about token exchanges, service tokens, and downstream caches. Two-step modal with checkbox "I understand".

irene: Action items: sam -> implement /internal/keys/{kid}/resolve + permission gating. luke -> telemetry span + audit events. maya -> Console UI + modal + truncated KID. natalie -> billing note + docs. I'll create a tracking ticket in eng-platform.

sam: Est. 3d backend, 2d to wire up frontend + help on gating.

maya: I can take the 2d frontend work and UX for the modal. I'll pair with sam for the permission checks.

irene: Great — thanks everyone. We'll sync this in the eng-platform weekly and mark the feature-flagged rollout. :thumbsup:
